intent: Remove from the monorepo two things that do not belong in it: a 12GB tree of third-party clones, and a self-contained analyzer package.
changes: git subtree split preserved session_autopsy's history; it only ever imported itself, so the extraction needed nothing but python_pkg.session_autopsy -> session_autopsy.

The 12GB tree was moved by rename (same filesystem) and gitignored. What is tracked instead is servers.json - upstream URL, branch and exact commit for all 24 - plus an idempotent setup.sh that reconstructs the fleet. 20KB tracked in place of 12GB.
12 absolute-path references rewritten across ~/.claude.json and three mcp-optional configs.

verification.evidence: exit 0, hook.log empty, store grew to 275 sessions. An earlier run failed with an AttributeError that turned out to be a stale __pycache__ from before the restructure, not a code fault - a clean run ingests 1,026 assistant messages.

verification.command: python3 -c '<assert every mcpServers command path exists>'
verification.evidence: 5 servers now under mcp-servers/ all resolve (reflex, servo-fetch, vestige, toolport, go-docs-mcp); no broken command path in any config.
Every difference between the extracted and original copies mentions the package name - i.e. imports only.

risks: MCP servers already running from the old path keep their old cwd until the session restarts; new sessions pick up the rewritten config.
servers/ binaries under target/ are build output: a fresh clone needs setup.sh plus a per-server build before the registrations work.
rollback: git revert this commit restores the package; the clones can be moved back with a single mv and the config paths rewritten in reverse.
Config backups were taken to the session scratchpad before rewriting.
